title: Clan archers and pikemen
changes: Clan armies now field archers and pikemen alongside their line soldiers, each clan in its own way: Warden longbowmen and pikemen, Redfang slingers, Ossuary Host bone archers and pike phalanxes, Hide-Kin burrow-spears and Veiled sun-casters.
Archers keep their distance and shoot; pikemen out-reach a charging foe and hold their post. Archer shots hit pikemen hardest.
